name: camayoc_unvalidated_metric_claims
description: Q4: metric-to-requirement claims whose probe has no falsifier-gated validation. Absence is reported as unvalidated, never as valid.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?metric ?metricLabel ?requirement ?probe WHERE { ?metric a aegis:Metric ; rdfs:label ?metricLabel ; aegis:measuresRequirement ?requirement ; aegis:probe ?probe . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?metric aegis:probeValidatedBy ?verification . ?verification a aegis:Verification ; aegis:falsifier ?falsifier . } } ORDER BY ?metricLabel
